changesProposed.name: Y Combinator

verified.name: Y Combinator
verified.thesis: Y Combinator is a startup accelerator that invests $500k per company in select cohorts four times per year. The three-month program provides intensive mentorship, office hours with partners, and community access to help startups achieve better products, user bases, and fundraising options before Demo Day.
verified.notes: Garry Tan became President & CEO in January 2023. Jared Friedman succeeded Michael Seibel as Managing Partner in March 2024. Headquarters moved from Mountain View to San Francisco in spring 2023. Standard deal structure since January 2022: $125k for 7% equity + $375k uncapped SAFE with MFN.

changes.current: The world's largest accelerator has made a measurable hard-tech pivot: ~1 in 8 companies in the Winter 2026 batch builds something physical, and industrials & defense doubled cohort-over-cohort (17 to 35). Its Requests for Startups now call for counter-drone defense, space electronics, lunar manufacturing, and semiconductor supply chains — and its alumni already include Boom, Relativity, Astranis, and Helion.
